gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1581.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured blue on Drawing No. KH3079/1 commencing at its junction with the thoroughfare shown coloured green on the said drawing running in a north-westerly direction for about 100 m and terminating at its junction with Ming On Street to join the existing Baker Street. Proposed Name: BAKER STREET. Chinese Version: 必嘉街.

No. 1581.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured grey on Drawing No. KH 3079/1 commencing at its junction with the thoroughfare shown coloured green on the said drawing running in a north-westerly direction for about 160 m and terminating at its junction with the road shown coloured pink on the said drawing. Proposed Name: HUNG HOM WAN STREET. Chinese Version: 紅磡灣街.

No. 1581.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. KH 3079/1 commencing at its junction with the thoroughfare shown coloured green on the said drawing running in a north-easterly direction for about 65 m and terminating at its junction with Baker Street. Proposed Name: FUK CHI STREET. Chinese Version: 福至街.

No. 1581.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured green on Drawing No. KH 3079/1 commencing at its junction with the thoroughfare shown coloured grey on the said drawing running in a north-easterly direction for about 145 m and terminating at its junction with Bulkeley Street to join Dock Street. Proposed Name: PO LOI STREET. Chinese Version: 寶來街.
